title: Settings
auto_lock_description: Set how long of inactivity before the vault auto-locks and wipes sensitive state from memory.
auto_lock_never_warning: Never locking reduces security. We recommend setting an auto-lock time when you step away from your device.
auto_lock_notification_desc: Send a system notification when the vault is auto-locked (off by default).
auto_lock_on_background_desc: Lock the vault immediately when the app is sent to background (off by default). Screen lock always locks regardless of this setting.
auto_locked_notification: Your vault has been auto-locked due to inactivity.
master_password_warning: Please keep your master password safe. If lost, you will be unable to unlock the vault and all data will be unrecoverable!
password_updated: Password updated. Please re-login with your new password.
current_password_incorrect: Current password is incorrect. Please try again.
password_too_short: Password must be at least 8 characters
snapshot_retention_desc: Configure how many snapshots to keep for each object. Older snapshots may be auto-deleted.
confirm_delete_desc: This action cannot be undone. Delete {{count}} item(s)?
confirm_restore_desc: Restore {{count}} item(s) to their original location?
trash_restored_with_rebuilt_page: Original page was permanently deleted; rebuilt page "{{page}}" and restored object
trash_detail_load_failed: Failed to load trash item details
trash_delete_page_with_children_desc: {{count}} object(s) in this page will remain in trash; they can be restored individually (the page will be rebuilt) or deleted.
vault_directory_desc: Choose where vault data is stored. SAF directory is only supported on Android.
vault_directory_reset_local_confirm_mess: By switching to the local directory, vault data will be stored in the app's private directory. This data will be deleted when the app is uninstalled. It is recommended to export or backup your data before uninstalling.
vault_directory_restart_required_desc: The vault directory has changed. Please restart the app to run with the new directory.
vault_directory_explanation: Store vault data in a user-chosen directory so it is not deleted when the app is uninstalled. Switching directories requires migrating data and restarting the app.
vault_directory_unavailable: Changing the vault directory is not supported on {{platform}}.
vault_directory_invalid_desc: Access to the SAF directory has been revoked or the directory was deleted. Please re-select the directory to restore data sync.
vault_directory_invalid_toast: SAF directory access revoked. Go to Settings > Data Management to re-select.
backup_desc: Create encrypted backups of your vault data.
export_import_desc: Export or import your data in .solosoul format.
trash_empty: Trash is empty. Deleted items appear here and are automatically cleaned after 30 days.
trash_empty_filtered: No results for current filter. Try switching the type filter.
sensitivity_desc: Manage field-level sensitivity. Downgrading a field's protection requires password verification. Changes are audited and cannot be reverted without trace.
need_install_unknown_apps: Please enable "Install unknown apps" permission for SoloSoul in system settings, then tap Update again.
mandatory_update_desc: This version contains important security fixes. Please update immediately to keep your data safe.
backup_hint: Back up all vault data to a local snapshot. Restore anytime.
backup_reminder_desc: Notify you on unlock if you haven't backed up for the selected number of days.
backup_reminder_body: It has been a while since your last backup. Please go to Settings > Backup & Restore to create one.
backup_restore_confirm_body: Restore backup "{{name}}"? All current data will be replaced with the backup contents.
backup_delete_confirm_body: Delete backup "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
backups_stored_locally: Backups are stored locally in your vault directory.
export_hint: For external backup, use Export & Import to create portable .solosoul files.
export_desc: Select pages and objects to export as an encrypted .solosoul file.
import_desc: Import objects from a .solosoul file. Select a file, enter the export password, and preview before importing.
export_doc_desc: Export selected objects as a readable document; each object becomes one page. Attachments are listed but not embedded.
export_doc_preflight_failed: Export preflight failed. Please try again.
export_scope_load_failed: Failed to load export scope. Please try again.
export_err_password_too_short: Password must be at least 8 characters
export_err_password_require_letter_digit: Password must contain at least one letter and one digit
export_err_same_as_master_password: Export password must be different from your master password
export_err_total_size_exceeded: Total export size exceeds 1 GB limit
import_err_decrypt_failed: Decryption failed — wrong password or corrupted file
conflict_warning: {{count}} object(s) already exist in the vault and will be overwritten.
strategy_keepBoth_desc: Import as a new object with (Imported) suffix
sensitive_export_warning: Some selected items contain sensitive or critical data. The export file is encrypted — keep your password safe.
weak_password_confirm: The password you entered is weak. Are you sure you want to continue?
include_behavioral_desc: Export activity logs, search history, and AI conversation records
include_preferences_desc: Export your personal settings such as theme, language, and UI preferences
include_attachments_desc: Also export attached files such as images, PDFs, and scans
attachment_limit_single_size_behavior: The oversized attachment will not be exported and an error will be shown
attachment_limit_single_count_behavior: Excess attachments will not be saved and will be skipped during export
attachment_limit_total_size_behavior: Export cannot proceed; reduce attachments or export in batches
hint_contains_password_confirm: Your password hint contains parts of the password, which may leak private information. Are you sure you want to continue?
strategy_skipExisting_desc: Skip objects that already exist in the vault
strategy_overwrite_desc: Replace all existing data with imported data
password_required_for_decrypt: Enter the export password above to decrypt and preview
collections_empty: No custom collections yet. Create your first one above.
collections_smart_desc: Smart Collections are dynamic views that automatically show objects matching filter criteria. Smart filter conditions can be configured when creating a collection. Objects matching the filter appear automatically — no manual organization needed.
ai_risk_notice: AI features send data to external services. All features are disabled by default. Enable individual features below.
llm_cloud_privacy_hint: ⚠ Chat content will be sent to this third-party service ({name}). Please review its privacy policy.
llm_cloud_privacy_confirm_body: "{name}" is a third-party cloud service. Chat content (which may include data from your objects) will be sent to this service for processing and does not transit through SoloSoul servers.
llm_api_key_unchanged: Enter new API key (unchanged if empty)
ai_risk_desc: AI features send your data to external LLM providers for processing. By enabling these features:
ai_risk_li1: Your data will be transmitted to third-party AI services
ai_risk_li2: Data may be processed on servers outside your control
ai_risk_li3: No sensitive or restricted data should be shared via AI features
ai_risk_li4: You are responsible for complying with your organization's data policies
ai_risk_agree: I understand the risks and want to proceed
ai_chat_disabled: LLM features are disabled. Configure a provider to get started.
ai_save_conversation_failed: Failed to save conversation. Data may be lost. Please retry.
ai_system_prompt_software: Inject software info, user public data and usage stats
ai_system_prompt_desc: System prompt only includes info you actively share; sensitive data is never sent to AI
biometric_enable_prompt: Enter your master password to enable {{type}}
biometric_disable_prompt: Enter your master password to disable {{type}}
biometric_credential_expired_unlock: Password changed. Please use password and re-enable biometrics.
biometric_not_available: {{type}} is not available on this device
biometric_locked_out: Too many failed attempts. Please use your password.
biometric_save_failed: Failed to save {{type}} credential. Please try again.
biometric_error_platform_not_supported: Biometric authentication is not supported on this platform
biometric_error_stale_credential: Biometric credential is stale; please log in with password and re-enable
biometric_error_not_configured: Biometric not configured; please enable first
biometric_weak_warning: {{type}} on this device is Class 2 (weak) biometric, which is less secure than Class 3 (fingerprint/IR face). Only enable if you understand the risks.
biometric_weak_unsupported: Face recognition on this device is a weak biometric (Class 2) and does not meet SoloSoul's security requirements. Please use fingerprint (Touch ID), PIN, or your master password instead.
biometric_unavailable_desc: Biometric authentication (Touch ID / Face ID / Windows Hello) is not available or not set up on this device. Please configure biometrics in System Settings, then reopen this page.
biometric_lockout_desc: Biometric authentication is locked due to too many failed attempts. Please try again later, or re-enroll in system settings if it remains unavailable.
biometric_error_user_presence_unavailabl: Biometric authentication is not available on this device. Please set up Touch ID, Windows Hello, or a device password.
biometric_error_lockout: Biometric authentication is temporarily locked due to too many failed attempts. Please try again later.
biometric_error_keychain_write_failed: Failed to save credential to Keychain
biometric_error_keychain_read_failed: Failed to read credential from Keychain
biometric_error_keychain_item_not_found: Biometric credential not found in Keychain
pin_desc: Use a {{length}}-digit PIN for quick unlock
pin_not_configured_desc: Set a PIN code to unlock quickly without entering your master password every time.
pin_mismatch: PIN codes do not match. Please try again.
pin_confirm_desc: Enter the PIN again to confirm
pin_disable_desc: After disabling, you will need your master password to unlock. Enter your master password to confirm.
pin_locked_warning: PIN is locked. Please use your master password to unlock.
pin_error_too_short: PIN must be at least 4 digits
pin_error_too_long: PIN must be at most 8 digits
pin_error_setup_failed: Failed to set PIN. Please try again.
pin_error_disable_failed: Failed to disable PIN. Please try again.
pin_error_locked: PIN is locked. Please use your master password.
pin_error_not_configured: PIN is not configured. Please set it up first.

ai_quick_chat_configure_hint: Please configure an LLM to use AI chat
template_delete_confirm_body: Delete template "{{name}}"? It can be restored or permanently deleted from trash within {{days}} days.
template_delete_confirm_body_never: Delete template "{{name}}"? It can be restored from trash.
deprecated_fields_hint: The following fields are marked as deprecated. You cannot clean them up as long as any object (including those in trash) is still using them.
field_in_use_both: Still used by {{activeCount}} active and {{softDeletedCount}} trash object(s)
field_safe_to_clean: This field is not used by any object and can be safely cleaned up
confirm_deprecate_body: This field is used by {{activeCount}} active object(s) and {{softDeletedCount}} trash object(s). It will be marked as deprecated — existing data will not be lost.
llm_embed_models_desc: Download local models to use vector search even when your LLM provider doesn't support Embedding APIs. Models run locally — no data is uploaded.
llm_kb_embedding_supported: Current LLM service supports vector search. Knowledge base index improves AI response accuracy.
llm_kb_embedding_unsupported: Current LLM service does not support vector search. Basic keyword matching will be used instead.
llm_stats_desc: View LLM Token usage and conversation statistics
llm_confirm_delete_model: Are you sure you want to delete this model?
llm_enable_local_first: Please download a local model first
llm_no_data_hint: Statistics will appear after starting AI conversations
llm_reset_confirm_desc: Are you sure you want to reset all LLM usage statistics? This action cannot be undone.
sidebar_button_mode_desc: Choose how card-supported buttons behave: Card mode shows a floating panel, Page mode navigates to the full feature page.
sample_templates_desc: Use these examples to quickly create common templates.
plugin_badge_tooltip: This template is bound to the {{pluginName}} plugin; field data can be read by the plugin
sync_online_tooltip: "Online" means the device is currently reachable on your local network (contacted within the last 5 minutes); otherwise it shows "Not found on LAN" — the device may be off, have sync disabled, or be isolated on another network.
sync_device_input_hint: Enter a discovered device ID or a host:port address.
sync_no_devices: No devices known yet. Enable sync and sync with another device to add it.
sync_discovered_hint: Nearby devices advertising SoloSoul sync will appear here.
sync_no_devices_found: No devices found. Click Discover to scan.
sync_manual_fallback_hint: If automatic discovery fails, ensure both devices are on the same Wi-Fi and enter the other device's IP address and port below.
sync_pairing_warning: Only trust devices you physically own or control. An attacker could impersonate your device.
sync_pairing_verify_prompt: Verify the fingerprint below matches the one shown on the other device:
sync_pairing_sas_prompt: Compare the verification code below with the one shown on the other device. Both devices must show the same number:
sync_pairing_sas_hint: If the codes match, the devices are verified. Confirm, then accept the pairing request on the other device.
sync_pairing_confirm_hint: Verify the fingerprint below, then confirm. The other device must also accept the pairing request.
sync_pairing_waiting: Trusted. Waiting for the other device to accept the pairing request... (auto-retrying)
sync_pairing_wait_failed: The other device hasn't confirmed the pairing yet. Try again later.
sync_revoke_tooltip: Revoke trust: keep the record but reject its syncs
sync_forget_tooltip: Forget: delete the record, you'll need to re-pair
sync_pair_tooltip: Verify the fingerprint and trust this device
sync_known_devices_hint: Devices you've discovered or connected to before; only trusted devices can sync
sync_forget_confirm_desc: The connection record will be deleted. You'll need to pair again to sync.
sync_qr_pairing_desc: Show a QR code for another device to scan, or scan another device.
sync_err_not_enabled: Sync is not enabled or the listen port is not ready. Enable sync first.
sync_err_not_running: Sync service is not running. Please enable sync and try again.
sync_err_enable_timeout: Enabling sync timed out. Please try again.
sync_err_discovery_timeout: Device discovery timed out. Check your network and try again.
sync_err_nsd_failed: Failed to register the network discovery service. Sync has been disabled. Please try again.
sync_err_peer_not_discovered: Cannot reach device: {{detail}}. Please re-scan and try again.
sync_err_connect_timeout: Connection timed out — make sure the other device has sync enabled, is online, and is on the same network
sync_err_connect_refused: Connection refused — check that the other device has sync enabled and no firewall is blocking it
sync_err_connect_unreachable: Network unreachable — make sure both devices are on the same network
sync_err_connect_no_route: Cannot reach the other device — check your network configuration
sync_err_handshake_vault_locked: Vault is locked. Please unlock the vault before syncing with this device
sync_err_pairing_pending: The other device hasn't trusted this device yet. Confirm the pairing on the other device and retry ({{detail}})
sync_auto_desc: Sync automatically when the app returns to foreground, after local data changes, and periodically every minute.
sync_ui_prefs_desc: Sync appearance settings (theme, accent color, etc.) with other devices.
llm_delete_provider_body: Are you sure you want to delete this provider?
llm_save_provider_failed: Failed to save provider. Please try again.
scan_select_dir_desc: Choose a folder to scan for documents
scan_no_supported_files: No supported files found in this directory.
no_plugin_contracts_available: No installed plugin contracts available (install a plugin with role definitions)
sync_completed_inbound: Inbound sync completed: {{examined}} examined · {{applied}} applied · {{skipped}} skipped · sent {{outbound}} back
vault_directory_invalid_message: SAF directory access is invalid or has been removed. Please reselect the directory in Settings > Data Management.
